caption: The drawing features a wooden door with a rounded top, composed of three vertical panels, set into a stone wall. The door is rendered in shades of brown, depicting a wood grain texture. The surrounding wall is depicted in light, muted tones of beige, gray, and hints of pastel teal to suggest stone or plaster. Above the door, there is a decorative painted arch with two red lines following the arch of the doorway, topped by a central red circle and flanked on each side by stylized red triangles and blue curving lines, resembling sun rays or a feathered motif. The floor in front of the door is illustrated with a pattern of terracotta-colored tiles, arranged diagonally. Near the lower right side of the image, there is a handwritten signature. The background is mostly plain and off-white, allowing focus on the central door and the surrounding architectural details.
title: Restoration Drawing Wall Painting and Door, Facade Mission House
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
